title: Ergodic measures of intermediate entropies for amenable group actions with an approximate product property
summary: We study entropy realization for continuous actions of infinite countable amenable groups. We introduce an approximate product property for amenable group actions that permits a small proportion of tracing mistakes on prescribed pairwise disjoint, sufficiently invariant finite sets. We prove that this property implies entropy-denseness and almost entropy-approximability of every invariant measure.
